title: RPG Maker Maps Are Flat. I Fixed It.
author: TheED5
selftext:
Two weeks, over 180 changes. In MMO Studio 0.7.0 your characters can leap, dash and backflip, locks can be picked, markets have buy orders, recipes can be crafted three ways, and your RPG Maker maps can stand up off the page in the new diorama view. And at the end, something nobody has seen yet.

MMO Studio is a no-code, AI-native 2D MMORPG Game Engine. Create your own MMO or have your AI make it for you.

(BUT MY AI CAN MAKE AN MMO FOR ME FROM SCRATCH)  
Yeah, burn tokens to build on top of my engine? and even if you're vibe coding the engine makes it easy for you to go in and change thing by hand if needed.
